name: Bitcash
rootCause: Bitcash.cz, a Czech Bitcoin exchange, was compromised on 11 November 2013, leading to the theft of approximately 485 BTC (about $100,000 at the time) from both user wallets and site reserves. The attack involved unauthorized access to wallet infrastructure following server compromise, with subsequent phishing attempts targeting users. Server compromise enabled unauthorized access to wallet keys stored by Bitcash.cz's backend infrastructure. The architecture lacked sufficient privilege separation between the web server and wallet management, allowing attackers to drain user and hot wallets once administrative access was obtained.
